goal: Orchestrate externally built native models through frozen actual selected runtime lineage without inference on the async event loop or detached cancelled custody writes.
procedure: Freeze one exact native invocation and context hash per case and phase; bind its lineage to the paired plan and phase-specific checkpoint. Require external worker/factory/codec/read/meter qualification. Pin actual code through sealed descriptors and launch a bounded private subprocess with explicit environment. Reauthorize before sending private input, enforce pipe and time caps, and terminate its group under cancellation or failure. Read actual selected runtime context, existing native execution and current phase lineage through bounded fresh owned sessions with read-only SQL and strict reconcile=False recovery. Keep cancelled passive readers occupying their slots until connection cleanup. Decode only supplied producer completions and independently verify exact metering. Reauthorize before every selected custody registration and retain exact request/result pairs only after proof and current authority. Exercise transport and signed fictional contract fixtures, add an actual selected-fabric recovery/revocation gate, and leave real factory, codecs, meters, phase authority routing and update-exclusion proofs explicit. Bound each worker and native adapter passive callback pool before submission, retain its slot until the physical concurrent future completes after cancellation, and seal the frozen native task before encoding. Reauthorize at each inner private receipt get/recover_reference after metadata I/O instead of trusting the pre-recovery phase check. Predeclare the immutable run/snapshot/arm identity in each frozen native entry without introducing a circular payload/run digest. Resolve actual SelectedPhaseRoute against the same fresh owned read session; require the matching actual runtime and lineage and exact selected archive/history/context receipt. Propagate metadata-only custody authorization through context, judgment recovery and result verification, and refuse production current-head fallback. Copy the actual history controller original permission reader before installing the runtime phase gate, retain the same fresh owned connection, and pass a separate current artifact permission copy to archive custody. Deny comparison/provider/archive/manifest artifacts in generic model context while allowing only exact authenticated custody reads under current source closure. Permit the native ablation infrastructure only with complete arm-bound immutable archives and the production selected-route reader; require the actual qualified after-update exclusion proof. Instrument the physical ciphertext backend to prove no post-revocation fetch, rather than spying on overridable object methods bypassed by guarded reads.
authority: Procedure trace only. This code grants no source or evaluation permissions, produces no semantic verdict or model weights, qualifies no arbitrary code and creates no behavioral target truth.
validation: Ten real subprocess lifecycle cases and one physical passive-callback ownership case were exercised locally. The latest ten actual-runtime adapter contract cases and fifteen concrete passive-read cases pass, including actual selected-history controller typed fixture grants/evaluation withdrawal and physical no-open instrumentation. Native modules and unique selected-backend session tests compile. Component fixtures permit fifteen seconds for current-head tasks and thirty seconds for archived passive reads; these allowances do not qualify response latency. Selected-engine CI must run actual archived fresh-session and producer routes; real worker qualification, meters and the behavioral experiment are not certified.
failure_or_lesson: Cancelling an async await cannot terminate a synchronous inference adapter or a driver thread. Inference needs a terminable process; passive reads need fresh owned bounded connections and must never reconcile after cancellation. Current Claim/state/artifact authority cannot by itself preserve a before judgment after a genuine after update: frozen semantic phase routing is still required while consent stays current. Same-evidence general-model output is not an update-exclusion ablation. A phase grant can disappear during private metadata I/O, so each inner receipt decryption needs its own current gate. Cancelling an asyncio wrapper is not physical driver-thread completion: use the actual concurrent future for slot ownership and prevent same-task encoder retries from opening a second invocation. A standalone phase metadata checker is insufficient if the actual fresh reader continues to use current runtime heads: bind the actual selected phase runtime and lineage together. A snapshot containing the run digest cannot also put its own payload/event hashes into that digest; predeclare its immutable identity and authenticate its exact bytes through custody. Fixture deadline expansion does not qualify performance. A phase-history controller using the same permission object being fenced can recursively call itself; copy its current original permission reader before applying the runtime gate and keep both on the same owned selected connection. Phase archive custody needs an exact authenticated artifact permission route independent of generic original-only model context. A guarded reader deliberately bypasses overridable object instance methods, so no-open tests must observe the actual ciphertext backend or AEAD boundary.
notes: All model outputs and meter counters in contract tests are explicitly supplied fictional fixture material. No model, live API request, checkpoint download or backend deployment credential was created. Linux sealed-code transport is not a consumer Windows executable or OS sandbox. Independently qualified producer phase/export/update-exclusion proofs and physical backend deadline faults remain external. Procedure traces are not a qualified linked FBM dataset.
